::  One additive receipt-bearing save. Legacy policy and body mutation gates
::  remain shared. No model, file-source or application-install authority.
++  doc-receipted-host
  |=  [b=bowl:gall i=document-save-intent:noltbook body=@t st=state-78 rs=document-receipts:noltbook]
  ^-  [next=state-78 saved=document-receipts:noltbook answer=document-receipt-reply:noltbook cards=(list card)]
  ?.  &((valid:dr i) =(host.i our.b) =(body-hash.i (shax body)))
    [st rs [i %refused ~] ~]
  =/  old  (lookup:dr i rs)
  ?.  =(%missing status.old)  [st rs old ~]
  =/  nt  (~(get by notes.st) note-id.i)
  ?~  nt  [st rs [i %refused ~] ~]
  ?.  &(=(creator.u.nt our.b) (can-edit-document note-id.i actor.i notes.st note-admins.st note-muted.st))
    [st rs [i %refused ~] ~]
  =/  started  (begin:dr i rs)
  ?:  ?=(%| -.started)  [st rs p.started ~]
  =/  out
    (doc-apply-save now.b note-id.i actor.i body expected.i documents.st document-history.st)
  =/  receipt=document-save-receipt:noltbook  [i res.out now.b]
  =/  rs  (finish:dr receipt p.started)
  =/  changed=?  ?=(%saved -.res.out)
  =/  next=state-78  st(documents docs.out, document-history hist.out)
  ?.  changed  [next rs [i %recorded `receipt] ~]
  =/  doc  (~(got by documents.next) note-id.i)
  =/  fan=(list card)
    %+  murn  ~(tap in users.u.nt)
    |=  who=@p
    ?:  =(who our.b)  ~
    `(rpoke /doc-out/(scot %p who)/[note-id.i] who `remote:noltbook`[%remote-document-updated note-id.i doc])
  =/  next=state-78
    %=  next
      note-activity  (put-activity note-activity.next note-id.i now.b)
      note-unread-activity
        ?:  =(actor.i our.b)  note-unread-activity.next
        (put-unread-activity note-unread-activity.next note-id.i now.b)
    ==
  :-  next
  :-  rs
  :-  [i %recorded `receipt]
  %+  weld  fan
  :~  (gf-notes [%document-updated note-id.i doc (doc-stats-of note-id.i document-history.next)])
      (activity-fact note-id.i now.b)
  ==

=/  retained=document-receipts:noltbook
    ?.  ?=([%79 *] q.old)  *document-receipts:noltbook
    =/  wrapped  !<(state-79 old)
    receipts.wrapped
  ?>  (sane:dr retained)
  =/  old=vase
    ?.  ?=([%79 *] q.old)  old
    =/  wrapped  !<(state-79 old)
    !>(legacy.wrapped)
[:(weld prof-cards call-cards (ensure-data-desk bowl)) this(state loaded, receipts retained)]

[%x %api %document-receipts ~]
    ?.  =(src.bowl our.bowl)  ~
    =/  value=json
      %-  pairs:enjs:format
      :~  ['schema' s+'noltbook-document-receipts-capability-v1']
          ['ship' s+(scot %p our.bowl)]
          ['version' (numb:enjs:format 1)]
          ['capacity' (numb:enjs:format 256)]
          ['retained' (numb:enjs:format ~(wyt by receipts))]
      ==
    ``[%json !>(value)]
      [%x %api %document-receipts @ @ @ ~]
    ?.  =(src.bowl our.bowl)  ~
    =/  host=(unit @p)  (slaw %p i.t.t.t.path)
    =/  req=(unit @ud)  (slaw %ud i.t.t.t.t.t.path)
    ?~  host  ~
    ?~  req  ~
    ?.  &(=(i.t.t.t.path (scot %p u.host)) =(i.t.t.t.t.t.path (scot %ud u.req)))  ~
    =/  held  (~(get by receipts) [u.host our.bowl u.req])
    ?~  held  ~
    ?.  =(i.t.t.t.t.path note-id.intent.u.held)  ~
    ``[%json !>((json:dr (lookup:dr intent.u.held receipts)))]

%save-document-receipted
      =/  i=document-save-intent:noltbook
        [host.act our.bowl note-id.act request.act expected.act (shax body.act)]
      =/  prior  (lookup:dr i receipts)
      ?.  =(%missing status.prior)
        :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt prior])])
      =/  nt  (~(get by notes) note-id.act)
      ?~  nt  :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt [i %refused ~]])])
      ?:  (is-write-blocked note-id.act host-status notes our.bowl)
        :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt [i %refused ~]])])
      ?.  &(=(host.act creator.u.nt) (can-edit-document note-id.act our.bowl notes note-admins note-muted))
        :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt [i %refused ~]])])
      ?:  =(host.act our.bowl)
        =/  out  (doc-receipted-host bowl i body.act state receipts)
        :_  this(state next.out, receipts saved.out)
        (weld cards.out ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt answer.out])])
      =/  started  (begin:dr i receipts)
      ?:  ?=(%| -.started)
        :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt p.started])])
      :_  this(receipts p.started)
      ~[(rpoke /doc-save-receipted/[note-id.act]/(scot %ud request.act) host.act `remote:noltbook`[%remote-document-save-receipted i body.act])]
        %request-document-save-receipt
      =/  i  intent.act
      ?.  =(actor.i our.bowl)  `this
      =/  found  (lookup:dr i receipts)
      ?:  |(=(host.i our.bowl) !=(%pending status.found))
        :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt found])])
      :_  this
      ~[(rpoke /doc-receipt-request/[note-id.i]/(scot %ud request.i) host.i `remote:noltbook`[%remote-document-receipt-request i])]

?:  ?=(%remote-document-save-receipted -.rem)
      =/  i  intent.rem
      ?.  &(=(actor.i src.bowl) =(host.i our.bowl))  `this
      =/  out  (doc-receipted-host bowl i body.rem state receipts)
      :_  this(state next.out, receipts saved.out)
      %+  weld  cards.out
      ~[(rpoke /doc-receipt/(scot %p src.bowl)/[note-id.i] src.bowl `remote:noltbook`[%remote-document-receipt answer.out])]
    ?:  ?=(%remote-document-receipt-request -.rem)
      =/  i  intent.rem
      ?.  &(=(actor.i src.bowl) =(host.i our.bowl))  `this
      :_  this
      ~[(rpoke /doc-receipt/(scot %p src.bowl)/[note-id.i] src.bowl `remote:noltbook`[%remote-document-receipt (lookup:dr i receipts)])]
    ?:  ?=(%remote-document-receipt -.rem)
      =/  answer  reply.rem
      =/  i  intent.answer
      ?.  &(=(actor.i our.bowl) =(host.i src.bowl))  `this
      =/  held  (lookup:dr i receipts)
      ?.  =(%pending status.held)  `this
      ?:  =(%recorded status.answer)
        ?~  receipt.answer  `this
        ?.  =(intent.u.receipt.answer i)  `this
        :_  this(receipts (finish:dr u.receipt.answer receipts))
        ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt answer])]
      :_(this ~[(gf-notes [%document-save-receipt answer])])

::  Additive durable document-save protocol. Existing save-document is unchanged.
+$  document-save-intent
  $:  host=@p  actor=@p  note-id=@ta  request=@ud
      expected=@ud  body-hash=@ux
  ==
+$  document-save-receipt
  $:  intent=document-save-intent  result=document-save-result  at=@da
  ==
+$  document-receipt-entry
  [intent=document-save-intent receipt=(unit document-save-receipt)]
+$  document-receipt-key  [host=@p actor=@p request=@ud]
+$  document-receipts  (map document-receipt-key document-receipt-entry)
+$  document-receipt-reply
  $:  intent=document-save-intent
      status=?(%recorded %pending %missing %refused %capacity)
      receipt=(unit document-save-receipt)

old: $%  [%remote-invite note-id=@ta name=@t type=note-type creator=@p users=(set @p) visibility=note-visibility writable=?]
new:
$%  [%remote-document-save-receipted intent=document-save-intent body=@t]
      [%remote-document-receipt-request intent=document-save-intent]
      [%remote-document-receipt reply=document-receipt-reply]
      [%remote-invite note-id=@ta name=@t type=note-type creator=@p users=(set @p) visibility=note-visibility writable=?]

$%  [%save-document-receipted host=@p note-id=@ta body=@t expected=@ud request=@ud]
      [%request-document-save-receipt intent=document-save-intent]
      [%create-note name=@t parent=(unit @ta)]

lib/noltbook-document-receipts.hoon.create:
::  Immutable request identities; bounded without evicting unknown deliveries.
/-  n=noltbook
|%
++  key
  |=  i=document-save-intent:n
  ^-  document-receipt-key:n
  [host.i actor.i request.i]
++  valid
  |=  i=document-save-intent:n
  ^-  ?
  ?&  (gte (met 3 note-id.i) 1)  (lte (met 3 note-id.i) 128)
      (gth request.i 0)  (lte (met 0 request.i) 53)
      (lth expected.i 9.007.199.254.740.991)  (lte (met 0 body-hash.i) 256)
  ==
++  receipt-valid
  |=  r=document-save-receipt:n
  ^-  ?
  ?&  (valid intent.r)
      ?-  -.result.r
        %saved  =(revision.result.r +(expected.intent.r))
        %no-change  =(revision.result.r expected.intent.r)
        %conflict  !=(current.result.r expected.intent.r)
        %too-large  =(limit.result.r 1.048.576)
        %denied  %.y
        %no-such-note  %.y
      ==
  ==
++  lookup
  |=  [i=document-save-intent:n store=document-receipts:n]
  ^-  document-receipt-reply:n
  ?.  (valid i)  [i %refused ~]
  =/  held  (~(get by store) (key i))
  ?~  held  [i %missing ~]
  ?.  =(i intent.u.held)  [i %refused ~]
  [i ?~(receipt.u.held %pending %recorded) receipt.u.held]
++  begin
  |=  [i=document-save-intent:n store=document-receipts:n]
  ^-  (each document-receipts:n document-receipt-reply:n)
  =/  found  (lookup i store)
  ?.  =(%missing status.found)  [%| found]
  ?:  (gte ~(wyt by store) 256)  [%| [i %capacity ~]]
  [%& (~(put by store) (key i) [i ~])]
++  finish
  |=  [r=document-save-receipt:n store=document-receipts:n]
  ^-  document-receipts:n
  ?>  (receipt-valid r)
  =/  held  (~(got by store) (key intent.r))
  ?>  =(intent.r intent.held)
  ?^  receipt.held
    ?>  =(r u.receipt.held)
    store
  (~(put by store) (key intent.r) [intent.r `r])
++  sane
  |=  store=document-receipts:n
  ^-  ?
  ?&  (lte ~(wyt by store) 256)
      %+  levy  ~(tap by store)
      |=  [k=document-receipt-key:n e=document-receipt-entry:n]
      ?&  =((key intent.e) k)  (valid intent.e)
          ?~(receipt.e %.y &(=(intent.e intent.u.receipt.e) (receipt-valid u.receipt.e)))
      ==
  ==
++  json
  |=  reply=document-receipt-reply:n
  ^-  ^json
  =/  i  intent.reply
  =/  terminal=^json
    ?~  receipt.reply  ~
    =/  r  result.u.receipt.reply
    %-  pairs:enjs:format
    :~  ['result' s+(scot %tas -.r)]
        :-  'revision'
        ?-  -.r
          %saved  (numb:enjs:format revision.r)
          %no-change  (numb:enjs:format revision.r)
          %conflict  (numb:enjs:format current.r)
          %too-large  ~
          %denied  ~
          %no-such-note  ~
        ==
        ['limit' ?:(?=(%too-large -.r) (numb:enjs:format limit.r) ~)]
        ['recordedAt' s+(scot %da at.u.receipt.reply)]
    ==
  %-  pairs:enjs:format
  :~  ['schema' s+'noltbook-document-receipt-v1']
      ['host' s+(scot %p host.i)]
      ['requester' s+(scot %p actor.i)]
      ['noteId' s+note-id.i]
      ['requestId' (numb:enjs:format request.i)]
      ['expected' (numb:enjs:format expected.i)]
      ['bodyHash' s+(scot %ux body-hash.i)]
      ['status' s+(scot %tas status.reply)]
      ['receipt' terminal]
  ==

::  New durable save protocol: canonical finite numeric selectors.
    ?:  |(=('save-document-receipted' tag) =('request-document-save-receipt' tag))
      ?>  =(2 ~(wyt by obj))
      ?>  =(?:(=('save-document-receipted' tag) 5 6) ~(wyt by d))
      =/  text-field
        |=  key=@t
        ^-  @t
        =/  node  (need (~(get by d) key))
        ?>  ?=([%s *] node)
        p.node
      =/  number-field
        |=  key=@t
        ^-  @ud
        =/  node  (need (~(get by d) key))
        ?>  ?=([%n *] node)
        =/  val=@ud  (rash p.node dem)
        ?>  &(=(node (numb:enjs:format val)) (lte (met 0 val) 53))
        val
      =/  host-text  (text-field 'host')
      =/  host=@p  (slav %p host-text)
      ?>  =(host-text (scot %p host))
      =/  nid=@ta  `@ta`(text-field 'noteId')
      ?>  &((gte (met 3 nid) 1) (lte (met 3 nid) 128))
      =/  expected  (number-field 'expected')
      =/  req  (number-field 'requestId')
      ?>  (gth req 0)
      ?:  =('save-document-receipted' tag)
        [%save-document-receipted host nid (text-field 'body') expected req]
      =/  actor-text  (text-field 'requester')
      =/  actor=@p  (slav %p actor-text)
      ?>  =(actor-text (scot %p actor))
      =/  digest-text  (text-field 'bodyHash')
      =/  digest=@ux  (slav %ux digest-text)
      ?>  &(=(digest-text (scot %ux digest)) (lte (met 0 digest) 256))
      [%request-document-save-receipt [host actor nid req expected digest]]
